data.title: Financial Close Pipeline
data.objective: Automate the end-to-end financial close: ingest source financials, enforce data quality, produce statutory statements and management reporting, and publish a signed-off close on the Gold layer.
data.context: Runs entirely in Databricks. 3-tier medallion (Bronze -> Silver -> Gold) on Delta Lake with Unity Catalog governance. Orchestrated by Databricks Workflows against the close calendar.
data.constraints: Every layer must be reproducible and auditable (idempotent, versioned, lineage-tracked). No hard-coded metrics: KPIs are metadata-driven. Financials must tie out and be human-signed before publish.

data.title: Platform & Close Standards
data.content: Delta Lake tables; Unity Catalog schema per tier (bronze/silver/gold). PII masking applied at Silver. All jobs parameterized by close period. Expectations tracked via DLT / Great Expectations. GL is the source of truth for tie-outs.

data.title: Bronze - Raw Ingestion
data.goal: Land source financial data exactly as received for a durable, replayable record.
data.instructions: Ingest GL, sub-ledgers (AP/AR/FA), bank statements, and FX rates into Bronze Delta tables with no transformation. Capture load metadata and source watermarks.
data.inputs: ERP/GL exports, sub-ledger feeds, bank files, FX rate feed
data.outputs: bronze.* raw Delta tables (append-only, partitioned by load date)
data.acceptance: All expected source files landed for the period; row counts and control totals match source manifests.

data.title: Cleaning & Conforming
data.goal: Produce clean, consistent, canonical data before any accounting logic runs.
data.instructions: Deduplicate, standardize types and currencies, map source accounts to the canonical chart of accounts, conform dimensions (entity, cost center, period), and apply PII masking.
data.outputs: Conformed staging tables ready for validation
data.acceptance: Schema conforms to the canonical model; no duplicates; every record maps to a valid COA account and entity.

data.title: Data quality gate - checks pass?
data.criteria: Completeness (all entities/periods present), referential integrity (COA, dimensions), balance checks (debits = credits), and reconciliation to GL control totals within tolerance.

data.title: Remediate & Reprocess
data.goal: Resolve data quality failures without manual patching of downstream tables.
data.instructions: Triage failed expectations, quarantine bad records, fix source/mapping issues, and re-run cleaning for the affected partitions.
data.acceptance: All previously failing checks pass on re-run.

data.title: Silver - Conformed & Validated
data.goal: Provide a trusted, business-ready financial dataset as the single source for all Gold products.
data.instructions: Publish validated, conformed Silver tables: journal entries, trial balance, and conformed dimensions for the close period.
data.acceptance: Trial balance is balanced by entity and ties to GL; passes all Silver expectations.

data.title: KPI Metadata-Driven Engine
data.goal: Compute financial KPIs from a metadata registry so new metrics require config, not code.
data.instructions: Read KPI definitions (formula, grain, filters, target) from a metadata table and evaluate them against Silver to generate the metrics store.
data.outputs: gold.kpi_metrics (metric, entity, period, value, target, variance)
data.acceptance: Every active KPI definition resolves and computes; results reconcile to the underlying Silver figures.

data.title: Statutory Financial Statements
data.goal: Produce the three core statements from a single validated source.
data.instructions: Build statement datasets from Silver trial balance and journal entries, mapped through statement-line taxonomies.
data.acceptance: Statements are internally consistent (net income flows to equity and cash).

data.title: Custom Financial Reporting
data.goal: Deliver management and analytical reporting beyond the statutory statements.
data.instructions: Build curated report datasets - Sales Report, Expense Report, Forecast, and similar - from Silver and the KPI metrics store.
data.acceptance: Each report reconciles to the statutory statements and KPI metrics for the period.

data.title: Income Statement
data.goal: Report period revenue, expense, and profitability.
data.instructions: Aggregate P&L accounts by statement line and entity for the period, with prior-period and budget comparatives.
data.acceptance: Net income matches the trial-balance P&L total by entity.

data.title: Statement of Cash Flows
data.goal: Report cash generated and used across operating, investing, and financing.
data.instructions: Derive cash flow (indirect method) from balance-sheet movements and net income.
data.acceptance: Net change in cash ties to the movement in cash accounts on the balance sheet.

data.title: Balance Sheet
data.goal: Report financial position at period end.
data.instructions: Aggregate asset, liability, and equity accounts by statement line and entity at period end.
data.acceptance: Assets = Liabilities + Equity for every entity.

data.title: Gold - Curated & Published Marts
data.goal: Assemble the certified serving layer for the close.
data.instructions: Consolidate KPI metrics, statements, and custom reports into governed Gold marts with a semantic layer for BI tools.
data.outputs: Certified gold.* marts + BI semantic model
data.acceptance: All Gold products present, versioned, and lineage-complete for the period.

data.title: Reconciliation & tie-out - balanced?
data.criteria: Do the statements tie to the trial balance and to each other (net income -> equity -> cash), and are inter-company balances eliminated within tolerance?

data.title: Investigate Variances
data.goal: Explain or correct any tie-out breaks before sign-off.
data.instructions: Trace variances to source through lineage, correct mappings or logic, and rebuild the affected Gold products.

data.title: Controller / CFO Sign-off
data.review: Reconciled statements, the KPI pack, and material variance explanations for the period.
data.criteria: Controller and CFO approve the close; all mandatory reconciliations signed.

data.title: Close Complete & Published
data.deliverable: Signed-off statutory statements, KPI metrics, and management reports published on Gold and to BI.
data.success: Close completed within the calendar; all statements tie out; sign-off recorded with full lineage and audit trail.
